title: Stepwise code-to-circuit signal flow in the Button LED lesson
depth_change: Keep the existing Button LED educational-interpreter depth; project one provider event at a time onto canonical circuit identities without adding solver, firmware or physical depth.
deliverables: Pure per-event frame projection for read, branch and write from the existing Button LED educational trace.
Accessible play/pause/step/replay controls and a visible current code action/line linked to the active circuit frame.
Synchronized exact IDs and step state across breadboard, schematic and 3D views, with stale/unsupported traces cleared.
Focused unit tests and E2E at desktop and mobile, plus a lead-owned report and frozen snapshot.
acceptance: Read and branch frames highlight only the canonical input net/wires and board-input/button endpoints; write highlights only output/series nets and related board/resistor/LED endpoints, including occupied holes.
Invalid, stale, unsupported, disconnected or out-of-range frames contain no active wire/key/part highlight; unrelated nets never light.
Controls are keyboard accessible; the current step exposes the existing event kind, source line/snippet and interpreter boundary in an accessible status.
The same step survives projection changes among breadboard, schematic and 3D; E2E covers 1440x900 and 375x812 without page-width overflow.
Editing code/topology, changing board/input or receiving unsupported code stops playback and clears old highlights until the user reruns.
Reduced-motion preference prevents automatic advancing/pulsing; manual previous/next remains usable.
Focused tests, typecheck, full unit tests, local build and full E2E pass on the final reviewed snapshot.
verification_plan: TDD pure trace-frame tests against the canonical Button LED document, including pressed/released, invalid, stale, unsupported and out-of-range cases.
Test UI play/pause/step/replay and event-to-frame synchronization without inferring voltage or current.
Run focused tests, typecheck, full unit suite, build:local and full test:e2e sequentially after QA review.
authorization: Founder authorized continuous implementation of the approved one-screen learning flow and visible code-to-circuit signal behavior. This is a bounded implementation of the approved §12.5 trace requirement on the existing Button LED educational interpreter. It does not change the provider, schema, hardware, firmware, data storage, services or electrical claims.

verification.scope: Pending independent QA and Tester on the frozen attempt-0 source snapshot.
